Stateful vs. Stateless MCP core.

(Anthropic's biggest MCP update)

Let me explain what that means:

Until this release, talking to an MCP server worked like a phone call. Both sides ran an initialize handshake, and the server returned a session id carried on every later request. https://t.co/giNRDf0vy4 https://t.co/xkQSVjhhQQ
